translations.EN: Haven't checked yet. Keep your distance until I do.
translations.TL: Hindi pa ako nakakatingin. Lumayo ka muna hangga't hindi pa.

translations.EN: I don't know for sure. Back off and let me look.
translations.TL: Hindi ako sigurado. Umatras ka at hayaan mo akong tingnan.

translations.EN: Can't tell through this armor. Don't jump to conclusions.
translations.TL: Hindi masabi dahil sa suot ko. Huwag kang magbintang.

translations.EN: Too much blood to tell whose it is. Back away.
translations.TL: Masyadong maraming dugo para malaman kung kanino. Umatras ka.

translations.EN: I need a mirror first. Stop staring at me.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng salamin muna. Huwag mo akong titigan.

translations.EN: Unsure. I'll inspect myself in private.
translations.TL: Hindi sigurado. Magsusuri ako nang mag-isa.

translations.EN: Can't confirm. Keep your weapon holstered.
translations.TL: Hindi makumpirma. Huwag mong ilabas ang armas mo.

translations.EN: I don't know yet. Don't treat me like an infected.
translations.TL: Hindi ko pa alam. Huwag mo akong itrato na parang infected.

translations.EN: Unknown. Stay where you are until I know.
translations.TL: Hindi alam. Diyan ka lang hangga't hindi ko nasisiguro.

translations.EN: I can't confirm whether I've been bitten.
translations.TL: Hindi ko makumpirma kung nakagat ako.

translations.EN: Haven't had a chance to strip down and check properly.
translations.TL: Hindi pa ako nagkakaroon ng oras para maghubad at suriin.

translations.EN: There were too many hands grabbing at me to be certain.
translations.TL: Masyadong maraming humawak sa akin para makasiguro.

translations.EN: Felt teeth scrape, but can't see if it broke the skin.
translations.TL: Naramdaman ko ang ngipin, pero hindi kita kung bumaon.

translations.EN: Need someone with good light to inspect my back.
translations.TL: Kailangan ng may maayos na ilaw para tingnan ang likod ko.

translations.EN: Not sure yet. The wound is covered in dirt and blood.
translations.TL: Hindi pa sigurado. Balot ng dumi at dugo ang sugat.

translations.EN: Could be a scratch, could be teeth. Can't tell yet.
translations.TL: Pwedeng gasgas, pwedeng ngipin. Hindi pa masabi.

translations.EN: I haven't checked every spot yet. Need a minute.
translations.TL: Hindi ko pa nasusuri ang bawat parte. Bigyan mo ako ng sandali.

translations.EN: Cloth is torn, but not sure if the skin is punctured.
translations.TL: Punit ang damit, pero hindi sigurado kung bumaon sa balat.

translations.EN: Bite status is unknown right now. Waiting to check.
translations.TL: Hindi pa alam kung nakagat. Naghihintay masuri.

translations.EN: Can't confirm.
translations.TL: Hindi makumpirma.

translations.EN: Not sure.
translations.TL: Hindi sigurado.

translations.EN: Haven't checked.
translations.TL: Hindi pa nasusuri.

translations.EN: Unknown.
translations.TL: Hindi alam.

translations.EN: Need to look.
translations.TL: Kailangang tingnan.

translations.EN: Hard to tell.
translations.TL: Mahirap sabihin.

translations.EN: Torn cloth.
translations.TL: Punit na damit.

translations.EN: Uncertain.
translations.TL: Hindi tiyak.

translations.EN: Can't see it.
translations.TL: Hindi ko makita.

translations.EN: Waiting to check.
translations.TL: Titingnan pa.

translations.EN: I can't confirm it, but thanks for checking.
translations.TL: Hindi ko makumpirma, pero salamat sa pagsuri.

translations.EN: I'm not sure yet, friend. I'll check carefully in a safe spot.
translations.TL: Hindi pa ako sigurado, kaibigan. Titingnan ko nang maayos sa ligtas na lugar.

translations.EN: Haven't had a proper look, but thank you for looking out for me.
translations.TL: Hindi ko pa natingnan nang maigi, pero salamat sa pagbabantay sa akin.

translations.EN: Hard to see back there. Mind helping me take a look soon?
translations.TL: Mahirap makita sa likod. Pwede mo ba akong tulungang tingnan mamaya?

translations.EN: Unsure right now, but I promise I'll be honest with you.
translations.TL: Hindi sigurado ngayon, pero nangangako akong magiging tapat ako sa 'yo.

translations.EN: I pray it's just a tear in my jacket. Thanks for asking gently.
translations.TL: Sana punit lang sa jacket. Salamat sa maingat na pagtatanong.

translations.EN: Not certain yet, but let's find shelter before we inspect.
translations.TL: Hindi pa tiyak, pero maghanap muna tayo ng masisilungan bago sumuri.

translations.EN: Could be nothing, could be bad. Thank you for staying calm.
translations.TL: Pwedeng wala lang, pwedeng masama. Salamat sa pananatiling kalmado.

translations.EN: I haven't checked every scratch, but your concern warms my heart.
translations.TL: Hindi ko pa nasusuri ang bawat gasgas, pero nagpapasalamat ako sa pag-alala mo.

translations.EN: I'll let you know the moment I check. Thank you for your care.
translations.TL: Sasabihin ko agad pagkatapos kong masuri. Salamat sa malasakit mo.
